# Upstream rendering fixtures

`upstream.json` contains 14 golden cases generated by executing only the pure
release-note rendering and label-classification functions extracted from
`reference/upstream/app/latest_changes.py` at revision
`40ba35e399a1c799029280832840f57cc6bf1c24`.

Cases cover new documents, existing and historical sections, section ordering,
legacy entries, CRLF normalization, idempotency, invalid headings, and invalid
category combinations. No Python runtime is needed to run the Go tests.

The snapshot and adapted behavior retain the upstream MIT license notice.
